provider: NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR) · RadLab
unit_note: RadLab's API response carries no unit field and its documentation was unavailable when this dataset was retrieved, so the unit is not stated here.
timestamp_note: Timestamps are shown exactly as published by RadLab, which does not state a time zone.
transformation_steps: Validated 5359 rows from the API response with the RadLabReading model.
Grouped by instrument id and kept the published time order.
Kept every value, timestamp and instrument id exactly as published; nothing was filled in, rounded or dropped as an outlier.
limitations: Historical readings from instruments on past and current missions.
Not your radiation exposure, not live telemetry and not a cumulative dose.
Instruments differ in location, shielding and method, so their values are not directly comparable.
